div.head: Ine 27
div.ab: Se ðe dearnunga bearn gestrynð ⁊ geheleþ, nah se his deaþes wer, ac his hlaford ⁊ se cyning.
LXXI. Se ðe dearnenga bearn gestrieneð ⁊ gehileð, nah se his deaðes wer, ac his hlaford ⁊ se cyning.
Qui in occulto puerum genuerit et celabit, non habeat ipsius pueri weram, si occidatur, sed rex et dominus suus.
{LXXI} Se ðe dearnenga bearn gestrieneð ⁊ gehileð, nah se his deaðes wer, ac his hlaford ⁊ se cyning.
He who conceives a child out of wedlock and hides it – he will not have its wer upon its death, but [it goes to] his lord and the king.
He who begets an illegitimate child and disowns it shall not have the wergeld at its death, but its lord and the king shall [have it].
Whoever begets an illegitimate child and does not acknowledge it, has no right to the wergild at its death, but its lord and the king [have it].
Wer unehelich ein Kind zeugt und nicht anerkennt, erhält das Wergeld von dessen Tödtung nicht, sondern der Herr [des Unehelichen] und der König.
Whoever begets a child out of wedlock and does not acknowledge it does not receive the wergeld for its killing, but the lord [of the illegitimate child] and the king do.
